name: FFmpeg (BtbN GPL builds; Martin Riedl builds on macOS)
license_note: Built with the BtbN 'gpl' variant: --enable-gpl --enable-version3 (confirmed by the shipped binaries' configuration string and by variants/defaults-gpl.sh LICENSE_FILE=COPYING.GPLv3), so the whole program is GPL-3.0-or-later. macOS: Martin Riedl's build is configured with --enable-gpl --enable-version3 (configuration string of both binaries, versions.txt on the download page), so it is GPL-3.0-or-later as well; it also links OpenSSL (Apache-2.0, compatible with GPLv3).

win-x64.note: Replaces the previous Gyan.dev ffmpeg-9.0.2-full_build-shared.zip entry in engines.json with the BtbN GPL build from the same release tag.

osx-arm64.note: Martin Riedl (https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de) release build 9.0.2 for macOS Apple silicon, built 2026-09-20, signed by its author (Developer ID Application: Martin Riedl, KU3N25YGLU); the signature is kept. ffprobe.zip of the same build (sha256 fcbe839537485eaee7a7a8bc5cbc0f90d53617e80943e8a5b2e31cb851197ea6, 28317701 bytes) is bundled next to it. Not a build Filee itself offers on macOS: Filee 2.0.0 has no FFmpeg download for macOS and uses one found on the PATH.

osx-x64.note: Martin Riedl release build 9.0.2 for macOS Intel (x86_64), built 2026-09-20, signed by its author; ffprobe.zip of the same build (sha256 2322438ed2f6319a691291b247d09c69dcaa3a982460d1f269a7e1af335cfdfd, 33719233 bytes) is bundled next to it.

binaries_note: sha256/size computed locally by downloading each archive (win64 zip 194034585 bytes hashed a0e45723..., matching the GitHub release asset digest sha256:a0e45723c72141975f51d8666302e614711745f3102b704ca3f82c897a58d278).

buildconf_check.method: 'configuration:' string of each shipped binary (ffmpeg -buildconf run under 'docker run --platform linux/arm64|amd64 ubuntu:22.04' for the two linux builds, 'strings ffmpeg.exe' for win-x64) compared against the source entries.
buildconf_check.result: every --enable-lib*/--enable-* flag that corresponds to a bundled library has a matching source entry; no mismatches.

build_recipe:
https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds at commit 6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b (the release tag autobuild-2026-09-30-13-08 points at this commit; the 'Build FFmpeg' workflow run 36713993443 that produced this release had head_sha 6c9aec5fc9a72ec3abedd1fa84db141fa18cf52b). Recipe: build.sh + generate.sh + variants/{linux64,linuxarm64,win64}-gpl.sh + variants/defaults-gpl.sh + variants/{linux,windows}-install-static.sh + scripts.d/**/*.sh + addins/9.0.sh (GIT_BRANCH=release/9.0) + patches/ + images/ (base containers).

macOS (osx-x64, osx-arm64): Martin Riedl's FFmpeg build scripts, https://git.martin-riedl.de/ffmpeg/build-script at commit 6a611e19870e197bc37c6e4c7fccddebd3715466 (2026-09-20 "chore: ffmpeg (version 9.0.2)", the commit that sets version/ffmpeg to 9.0.2; the component versions of that commit equal the versions.txt published for both shipped binaries, 26 of 26 compared). `./build.sh` fetches each component's release tarball named in script/build-<component>.sh (pinned below with their SHA-256), builds them static and then FFmpeg with the configure flags in the shipped binaries' configuration string (--enable-gray --enable-libxml2 --enable-version3 --enable-gpl --enable-openssl --enable-libfreetype --enable-fontconfig --enable-libharfbuzz --enable-libbluray --enable-libsnappy --enable-libsrt --enable-libvmaf --enable-libass --enable-libklvanc --enable-libzimg --enable-libzvbi --enable-libaom --enable-libdav1d --enable-libopenh264 --enable-libopenjpeg --enable-librav1e --enable-libsvtav1 --enable-libvpx --enable-libvvenc --enable-libwebp --enable-libx264 --enable-libx265 --enable-libmp3lame --enable-libopus --enable-libvorbis --enable-libtheora).
